experiments.experiment_label: Luciferase mRNA-LNP delivery in healthy mice
experiments.experiment_anchor_quote: We confirm specific hepatotropism of mRNA-LNP via intravenous injection of firefly luciferase encoding mRNA-LNP, with protein expression lasting about 3 days.
experiments.distinctness_reason: Different payload (luciferase) and purpose (delivery validation) compared to therapeutic experiments.

experiments.experiment_anchor_quote: In homeostasis, HGF mRNA-LNP efficiently induce hepatocyte proliferation.
experiments.distinctness_reason: Different payload (HGF), healthy model, and proliferation readout compared to other experiments.

experiments.experiment_label: HGF+EGF mRNA-LNP in chronic liver injury (NAFLD) model
experiments.experiment_anchor_quote: In a chronic liver injury mouse model recapitulating non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, injections of both HGF and EGF mRNA-LNP sharply reverse steatosis and accelerate restoration of liver function.
experiments.biological_model_mention: chronic liver injury mouse model recapitulating non-alcoholic fatty liver disease
experiments.distinctness_reason: Combination treatment (HGF+EGF) and chronic liver injury (NAFLD) disease context, distinct from healthy and acute injury models.

experiments.experiment_label: HGF+EGF mRNA-LNP in acute liver injury (acetaminophen) model
experiments.experiment_anchor_quote: Likewise, HGF and EGF mRNA-LNP accelerate liver regeneration after acetaminophen-induced acute liver injury with rapid return to baseline ALT levels.
experiments.biological_model_mention: acetaminophen-induced acute liver injury mouse model
experiments.distinctness_reason: Combination treatment (HGF+EGF) and acute liver injury (acetaminophen) disease context, distinct from chronic model and healthy model.
